title: From zero to CSRD-ready in 48 hours
intro: Most ESG platforms quote 4-month implementations. Nexus takes 2 days. Here's how.

why.heading: Four design choices that compress months into days.

frameworks.title: Frameworks pre-loaded
frameworks.body: 24 frameworks and 700+ datapoints are ready on day one — CSRD, ISSB, GRI, TCFD, CDP, SEC, EU Taxonomy and more. No template buildouts, no consultant-led configuration.

ai.title: AI does the heavy lifting
ai.body: Claude-powered evidence extraction reads supplier PDFs and invoices, draft generators write the narrative, and a vendor-to-emission-factor matcher handles the spend-based maths.

linked.title: Linked data, set once
linked.body: Change a single value — say, your London facility electricity figure — and every framework, every disclosure, every chart referencing it updates in lockstep.

onboarding.title: Self-serve onboarding
onboarding.body: The welcome wizard walks first-time admins through entity setup, framework selection, and team invites. No implementation consultant required, no professional services fees.

compare.heading: Legacy ESG platforms vs Nexus.
compare.intro: The honest summary across eight dimensions — without naming names. For a head-to-head against Workiva specifically, see <compareLink>/compare</compareLink>.

cta.heading: Stop quoting six months. Start in two days.
